title: 30A Townhomes C104 The Salty Dog Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A Townhomes at Seagrove rental C104, The Salty Dawg, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart Included! FEATURES
description_expanded: Description Description 30A Townhomes at Seagrove rental C104, The Salty Dawg, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 5 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Golf Cart Included! FEATURES * Golf Cart Included * Large Living Area - 60" Smart TV * Kitchen with Breakfast Bar * Dining Area * Bedroom 1 - King Bed, 32" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 2 - King Bed, 32" Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom * Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 32" Smart TV * Bathroom 3 - Spacious Tub/Shower Combo * Bedroom 4 - Queen Bed, 32" Smart TV * Bedroom 5 - 2 Bunk Beds (T/T, T/T), 42" Smart TV * Half Bathroom on Main Level * Full Size Washer/Dryer * Private Patio * Walk & Bike Everywhere * Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi * Sleeps 12 30A Beach Access Points * Please note there is a Ring doorbell at the front door.Note: Only 2 Parking Spaces are available per rental. ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) ABOUT 30A TOWNHOMES AT SEAGROVE 30A Townhomes at Seagrove is a community along 30A in the beloved beach town of Seagrove Beach, Florida. Guests will enjoy easy access to all things 30A, fantastic restaurants, boutique shopping and of course the beach! Families will enjoy relaxing by the community pool after a day of fun in the sun at the beach. AMENITIES COMMUNITY POOL BEACH ACCESS - .5 miles to Beach! SEAGROVE BEACH LOCATION FAMILY FRIENDLY COVERED BALCONIES PRIVATE PORCHES FENCED YARDS INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVAL Panhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
